headline: BoJ's Ueda Advocates Stabilizing Inflation at 2% and Monitors Global Escalation of Sovereign Interest Rates - Diário do Grande ABC
summary: Bank of Japan Governor Ueda advocated stabilizing inflation at 2 percent. He said the central bank is monitoring the global escalation of sovereign interest rates.
why: The Bank of Japan sets monetary policy for Japan, and its stance influences the yen, Japanese government bond yields and global carry trades.
